_help: The shop pair (UINpcShop.img/Shop on the left, UINpcShop.img/Inventory/Normal on the right). x/y = the left panel top-left in 1366x768 pixels. w/h = the left panel size (380x681); invW = the right panel width (324), with the same height. Left-panel local keys: titleX/titleY = the shop name, npcPortraitX/Y = the keeper's feet (same baseline as the player preview at Y=88), tabX/tabY/tabStep/tabW/tabH = the two left tabs, listX/listY/rowPitch/rowW/rowH = the ten stock rows, nameX/nameY/nameH/priceX/priceY/priceH = a row's text parts, countW/countRight = the right-aligned x count box. Right-panel local keys: invTabX/Y/Step/W/H = the four inventory tabs (drawn with the left tab art), invListX/Y/Pitch/W/H = the bag rows, invAvatarX/Y = the player's feet, invMesoBgX/Y = the coin background picture, invMesoX/Y = the right end of the meso number, invCloseX/Y/W/H = the X. notice* = the insufficient-meso box. qty* = the shared number-input popup used for buying and selling. tipX/tipY = the bottom instruction line. doubleClickMs = the double-click window.
